reason: The two methods perform identical comparisons: both check that the year, month, and day of month are equal. method1 uses Calendar to obtain the year, month, and date, while method2 uses the deprecated Date.getYear(), getMonth(), and getDate() methods. Since getYear() returns the year minus 1900, two dates that have the same Calendar year will also have the same getYear() value, and the month and day comparisons are identical. Therefore, for any pair of Date objects, the boolean results of method1 and method2 are always the same, and no concrete input can distinguish them.
